sentence: A {frog} jumped out of the grass and scared the cat.
translation: Из травы выпрыгнула лягушка и напугала кота.

definition: the force of an electric current
sentence: The {voltage} here is different, so bring an adapter.
translation: Здесь другое напряжение, так что возьми адаптер.

definition: to kill animals for meat, or to kill many people violently
sentence: On the farm they {slaughter} the pigs in late autumn.
translation: На ферме свиней забивают поздней осенью.

definition: to make someone feel afraid
sentence: The thunder {frightened} the dog and he hid under the bed.
translation: Гром напугал собаку, и она спряталась под кровать.

definition: a thick piece of meat or fish, usually fried or grilled
sentence: I'll have the {steak}, medium, with chips.
translation: Мне стейк средней прожарки с картошкой фри.

definition: an accident in which two vehicles or things hit each other
sentence: There was a {collision} at the crossing but nobody was hurt.
translation: На перекрёстке столкнулись машины, но никто не пострадал.

definition: a machine that carries people up and down in a building
sentence: The {elevator} is broken, so it's six floors on foot.
translation: Лифт сломан, так что шесть этажей пешком.

definition: a thin wooden stick with a black centre for writing or drawing
sentence: Write in {pencil} so you can change the answers.
translation: Пиши карандашом, чтобы можно было исправить ответы.

definition: to form a round shape, or to make hair twist into curves
sentence: Her hair {curls} by itself when it rains.
translation: Её волосы сами вьются, когда идёт дождь.

definition: to leave something in liquid for a long time, or to make it very wet
sentence: {Soak} the beans overnight before you cook them.
translation: Замочи фасоль на ночь, прежде чем варить.

definition: to bring back to life, health or use
sentence: A strong coffee {revived} me after the night shift.
translation: Крепкий кофе оживил меня после ночной смены.

definition: something that balances or cancels the effect of another thing
sentence: The bonus was a small {offset} for all the weekend work.
translation: Премия была небольшой компенсацией за работу по выходным.

definition: a person who catches fish
sentence: The {fishers} go out at four and come back with the sun.
translation: Рыбаки выходят в море в четыре и возвращаются с солнцем.

definition: something that causes problems or makes a thing less good
sentence: The only {disadvantage} of the flat is the lack of a lift.
translation: Единственный недостаток квартиры — нет лифта.

definition: a guess about the future based on information you have now
sentence: The {projection} says we'll sell twice as much next year.
translation: По прогнозу в следующем году мы продадим вдвое больше.

definition: a short fast run
sentence: The race ended with a {sprint} between two riders.
translation: Гонка закончилась спринтом двух гонщиков.

definition: a situation where there is not enough of something
sentence: There's a {shortage} of nurses in every hospital here.
translation: Здесь в каждой больнице не хватает медсестёр.

definition: a person who shows in public that they disagree with something
sentence: Hundreds of {protesters} filled the square by noon.
translation: К полудню площадь заполнили сотни протестующих.

definition: an official paper that proves you have passed a test or met a standard
sentence: You need a {certification} to teach yoga here.
translation: Чтобы преподавать йогу здесь, нужен сертификат.

definition: to make an illegal copy of a document or signature
sentence: Someone {forged} my signature on the contract.
translation: Кто-то подделал мою подпись на договоре.

definition: the act of including someone or something
sentence: The {inclusion} of a vegetarian menu was a good idea.
translation: Включить в меню вегетарианские блюда было хорошей идеей.

definition: to tell someone what to do, or to teach a skill
sentence: The doctor {instructed} me to rest for three days.
translation: Врач велел мне отдыхать три дня.

definition: to say hello or welcome someone
sentence: The dog {greets} every guest by jumping on them.
translation: Пёс встречает каждого гостя прыжками.

definition: a chance to see a film, show or product before the public
sentence: We got tickets to a {preview} of the new play.
translation: Мы достали билеты на предпремьерный показ новой пьесы.

definition: a small nut that grows under the ground, often eaten salted
sentence: Careful, the sauce has {peanuts} in it and he's allergic.
translation: Осторожно, в соусе арахис, а у него аллергия.

definition: a small object that makes a high sound when you blow it
sentence: The referee blew the {whistle} and the game was over.
translation: Судья дал свисток, и игра закончилась.

definition: a small town or an area of a town with its own local government
sentence: The {township} has its own fire station and school.
translation: В этом посёлке есть своя пожарная часть и школа.

definition: to make something better by making small changes
sentence: We {refined} the recipe until the bread stopped sinking.
translation: Мы дорабатывали рецепт, пока хлеб не перестал оседать.

definition: a large black wild cat
sentence: The {panther} watched us from a branch at the zoo.
translation: Пантера наблюдала за нами с ветки в зоопарке.

definition: a small group of trees
sentence: There's an olive {grove} behind the house.
translation: За домом оливковая роща.

definition: enough in amount or good enough for a purpose
sentence: The flat is small but {adequate} for one person.
translation: Квартира маленькая, но для одного человека вполне подходит.

definition: a yellow metal made of copper and zinc, or instruments made of it
sentence: The door handles are old {brass} and need polishing.
translation: Дверные ручки из старой латуни, их нужно почистить.

definition: a heavy fuel used in trucks and some cars
sentence: My car runs on {diesel}, don't fill it with petrol.
translation: Моя машина на дизеле, не заливай бензин.

definition: how well something works and gives the result you want
sentence: Nobody has measured the {effectiveness} of these pills.
translation: Никто не измерял эффективность этих таблеток.

definition: unusually good, much better than normal
sentence: The service at the hotel was {exceptional}.
translation: Обслуживание в отеле было исключительным.

definition: speaking honestly, even if it is not pleasant
sentence: {Frankly}, I don't think the dress suits you.
translation: Честно говоря, не думаю, что это платье тебе идёт.

definition: a very strong feeling of dislike
sentence: There's real {hatred} between the two football clubs.
translation: Между двумя футбольными клубами настоящая ненависть.

definition: not knowing things that you should know
sentence: I'm {ignorant} about cars, I can't even change a tyre.
translation: В машинах я полный ноль, даже колесо поменять не могу.

definition: a word used to speak to or about a king or queen, or great beauty
sentence: The guide said the castle still belongs to Her {Majesty}.
translation: Гид сказал, что замок до сих пор принадлежит Её Величеству.

definition: in the middle of a set of numbers arranged from lowest to highest
sentence: The {median} salary here is lower than people think.
translation: Средняя зарплата здесь ниже, чем люди думают.

definition: from the Middle Ages, between about the years 500 and 1500
sentence: The town has a {medieval} wall you can walk along.
translation: В городе есть средневековая стена, по которой можно гулять.

definition: the ability to move or travel around easily
sentence: After the operation his {mobility} improved a lot.
translation: После операции он стал двигаться намного лучше.

definition: at some time in the future, not known exactly
sentence: {Someday} I'll learn to play the piano properly.
translation: Когда-нибудь я научусь нормально играть на пианино.

definition: not moving or changing
sentence: The picture on the screen was {static} for a minute, then it froze.
translation: Картинка на экране минуту не двигалась, потом всё зависло.

definition: giving help and encouragement
sentence: My boss was very {supportive} when my father was ill.
translation: Мой начальник очень поддержал меня, когда болел отец.

definition: connected with operations done by doctors
sentence: The nurse put on {surgical} gloves and a mask.
translation: Медсестра надела хирургические перчатки и маску.

definition: the activity of fighting a war
sentence: The film shows modern {warfare} without any heroes.
translation: Фильм показывает современную войну без героев.

definition: a very small part or amount of something
sentence: We paid only a {fraction} of the usual price.
translation: Мы заплатили лишь малую часть обычной цены.

definition: a small soft square put on the floor by a door or in a bathroom
sentence: Wipe your feet on the {mat} before you come in.
translation: Вытри ноги о коврик, прежде чем войти.

definition: the border between two countries, or the edge of known land
sentence: The village sits right on the {frontier} with Italy.
translation: Деревня стоит прямо на границе с Италией.

definition: the quality of being easy to use or reach, saving time or effort
sentence: I pay more for the {convenience} of a shop under my flat.
translation: Я плачу больше за удобство магазина под квартирой.

definition: a person who has broken the law
sentence: Young {offenders} do community work instead of prison.
translation: Малолетние правонарушители вместо тюрьмы работают на благо общества.

definition: to break food into small pieces with your teeth
sentence: {Chew} slowly, the meat is tough.
translation: Жуй медленно, мясо жёсткое.

definition: the level of confidence and good feeling in a group
sentence: {Morale} in the office dropped after the third delay.
translation: После третьей задержки настроение в офисе упало.

definition: an area of short grass in a garden or park
sentence: I have to cut the {lawn} before it rains.
translation: Нужно подстричь газон, пока не пошёл дождь.

definition: a large group of musicians playing together
sentence: The {orchestra} played for free in the park on Sunday.
translation: В воскресенье оркестр бесплатно играл в парке.

definition: a large farm building for animals or crops
sentence: The wedding was in an old {barn} with lights on the walls.
translation: Свадьба была в старом амбаре с гирляндами на стенах.

definition: the angry feeling you get when you cannot do what you want
sentence: You could hear the {frustration} in her voice on the phone.
translation: По телефону в её голосе слышалось раздражение.

definition: one line of thread made with a needle in cloth or skin
sentence: The cut needed five {stitches} and a week of rest.
translation: На порез наложили пять швов и прописали неделю покоя.

definition: a very large animal that lived millions of years ago
sentence: My son knows the name of every {dinosaur} in the museum.
translation: Мой сын знает названия всех динозавров в музее.

definition: an example of something used for testing or study
sentence: The doctor asked for a blood {specimen} for the test.
translation: Врач попросил образец крови для анализа.

definition: a grey powder mixed with water and sand that becomes hard like stone
sentence: The {cement} has to dry for a day before you walk on it.
translation: Цемент должен сохнуть сутки, прежде чем по нему ходить.

definition: the act of leaving your job on purpose, or quiet acceptance
sentence: She handed in her {resignation} the day after the bonus.
translation: Она подала заявление об уходе на следующий день после премии.

definition: the distance from one side of something to the other
sentence: Measure the {width} of the door before you buy the fridge.
translation: Измерь ширину двери, прежде чем покупать холодильник.

definition: a thin white layer of ice that forms when it is very cold
sentence: There was {frost} on the car windows this morning.
translation: Утром окна машины покрылись инеем.

definition: to build or put up something, in formal language
sentence: They {erected} a huge tent for the wedding in two hours.
translation: Они за два часа поставили огромный шатёр для свадьбы.

definition: a serious promise
sentence: He made a {vow} never to drink again after that party.
translation: После той вечеринки он поклялся больше не пить.

definition: the part of a car that you press with your foot to change gear
sentence: I burned the {clutch} while learning to drive.
translation: Я сжёг сцепление, пока учился водить.

definition: one of the light soft things that cover a bird's body
sentence: The pillow is full of {feathers} and very soft.
translation: Подушка набита перьями и очень мягкая.
